notes.title: Alpha4 is out NOW!
notes.content:
Alpha4 is out. Grab your key and let’s play it together! 
If the key is not in your inbox check the spam folder, just in case...

Want to join? Subscribe [url=https://eepurl.com/drtBDj]here[/url] to participate.

[h3]Full changes list:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major graphics update
[*] New GUI
[*] Rehearsed movement and melee systems.
[*] 2 new tutorials (5 total now)
[*] The first iteration of the revolutionary "Base AI" system. The AI is trying to analyze your behavior and makes the enemies do unusually smart things.
[/list]

notes.title: Heist Giveaway
notes.content:
[b]Safe Not Safe[/b] is a modern safe cracking sim game in development. Inspired by cult classic immersive sims. It will feature (among other things):[list]
[*] Randomly generated levels
[*] Deep hacking system
[*] Destructible and traversible environments
[/list]

[b]Get a first taste of the game by beating alpha demo level. 
Let us know what you think and win one of the 6 keys for [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/238010/Deus_Ex_Human_Revolution__Directors_Cut/

[h1]To enter the "Heist Giveaway"[/h1][olist]
[*] Make sure you are subscribed to our newsletter: [url=http://eepurl.com/drtBDj]http://eepurl.com/drtBDj[/url]
[*] On [b]23.11[/b] every subscriber will get a mail with their personal demo Steam key. This key will give you access to the latest alpha version and all future alphas as well.
[*] Beat the "Heist Giveaway" demo level using any class. On the results screen you'll find a button leading to the giveaway signup form.
[*] Answer 3 simple questions there (helping us improve the game).
[*] Done!
[/olist]

[h1]Rules and conditions[/h1][list]
[*] 3 keys go to the players getting the best time record (1 key for each class Command, Ninja, Hacker).
[*] 3 keys are randomly distributed between all the remaining contestants.
[*] Up to 3 sign-ups allowed for each player (1 for each class).
[*] The game will save your best results, so you can try a few times before final submission.
[*] The event will last until 29.11 and the results will be announced on 30.11.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha3 is ready for playtests!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31784452/d9a6f112eca503867353156e0279694417abd979.gif[/img]
[h1]Alpha3 has arrived with tons of improvements on board[/h1]
[list]
[*] Short but useful tutorials for each class
[*] New collectables: energy cells, medkits and weapons to find and use
[*] Polished 20+ existing mechanics
[*] Improved hacking minigame for Hacker
[*] New lockpicking minigame for Ninja
[*] Indoor turrets
[*] Devices can trigger and active each other (read - nasty surprises)
[/list]

Those who missed on the release can still [url=https://eepurl.com/drtBDj]sign up here[/url].
